_note: Packages whose licence is not on the allow-list of tools/licenses.ts (MIT, ISC, Apache-2.0, BSD-*, BlueOak-*, 0BSD, CC0-1.0; Python-2.0 for dev only), each reviewed with a reason. A different licence for the same package needs a new entry. Recorded at refactor stage 0 (2026-10-13).

exceptions.reason: Runtime, transitive: @anthropic-ai/sdk → standardwebhooks → fast-sha256. Unlicense is a public-domain dedication (OSI-approved, permissive, no conditions).

Runtime, transitive: spdx-expression-parse / spdx-correct → spdx-exceptions. Data only (the SPDX exception id list); CC-BY-3.0 asks for attribution of the data, which ships unmodified with its LICENSE in node_modules.
Dev only (tests): spdx-satisfies → spdx-ranges. MIT code plus CC-BY-3.0 SPDX data; not shipped.

Dev only (build tool chain): vite (engine via vitest; web) and @tailwindcss/node → lightningcss and its per-platform binaries. MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft; it applies to lightningcss's own files, which are used unmodified at build time and not shipped.
Dev only (e2e accessibility checks): @axe-core/playwright → axe-core. Used unmodified in tests, not shipped.
Dev only (e2e accessibility checks). Used unmodified in tests, not shipped.
Dev only (jsdom → CSS parsing in unit tests). MIT-0 is MIT without the attribution condition: more permissive than MIT.

Runtime assets: the DM Sans and JetBrains Mono web fonts bundled into the web app. SIL Open Font License 1.1 allows bundling and redistribution with software; the fonts are not sold on their own and not renamed.
